title: SimpleSpawnMob
body:
SimpleSpawnMob

## 🎯 Features - **Easily Spawn Mobs** Spawn multiple Mobs with a single Command. - **NBT-Data** You can specify NBT-Data for the Mobs you Spawn, saving you the hassle of applying it individually to all Mobs.
### Admin Commands: ``` /spawnmob [amount] [nbt] - Spawn Mobs where you are Looking /spawnmobxyz [nbt] - Spawn Mobs at specific Coordinates ``` ### Permissions: ``` simplespawnmob.admin (Default: false) - Allow use of all SimpleSpawnMob Commands simplespawnmob.spawnmob (Default: false) - Allows use of the SpawnMob Command simplespawnmob.spawnmobxyz (Default: false) - Allows use of the SpawnMobXYZ Command ``` ### Config: ``` max-amount - Set Maximum Amount of Mobs Spawnable with 1 Command ```
